svg.aria-label: Tom Klotz, software engineer at Photoroom in Paris. His name is set like a magazine cover over his portrait; an animation removes the photo's background so he steps in front of his own name, then swaps in AI backgrounds made with Photoroom, outer space then Paris at dusk. Then a git graph of his career: Algolia, CastorDoc, Ministère des Armées, Photoroom. Highlights: Rookie of the Year in his first 4.5 months, 570+ pull requests merged and 540+ reviewed in 8 months, shipped Virtual Models, AI Video Gen, Share Links and Recommended edits, Code Connect coverage from 22% to 95%.
svg.text: I ship features in Photoroom's AI photo editor,
used by millions to make their photos shine.
